scope: Two actual candidate-only Codex CLI routing/reference-reuse probes; not product-quality trials or billing measurements
source_integrity: Both runs retained their entire skill snapshots and evaluator helper unchanged

a-reuse.phase_1: Read ai-slop-remover and ui-visual-refine in full plus principles, design memory, DESIGN.md and style.css; correctly proposed .failure gap:var(--gap) against the original 16px design role
a-reuse.phase_2: Reused in-context references/source with zero additional helper reads or direct shell reads; correctly found #save margin-top:var(--gap) already compliant. The task explicitly stated that files were unchanged; this does not prove independently refreshed hash validation
a-reuse.phase_3: Evaluator changed DESIGN.md only. Agent reread the new document, reported its new --control-gap:24px failure-group role, and proposed defining that missing token and mapping .failure to it. Agent hashed then fully reread unchanged style.css, an observed redundant read
a-reuse.phase_4: After explicitly simulated unavailable reference content, agent fully reread both selected skills, principles, design memory, current DESIGN.md and style.css; retained the new 24px proposal and explicitly denied actual runtime compaction
a-reuse.product_integrity: Only evaluator-owned DESIGN.md change; TASK.md, app.js, index.html and style.css unchanged

b-broad-routing.routing_observed: Task did not name composition reference files; agent fully read art-direction.md, color-composition.md and layout-composition.md through the helper
b-broad-routing.proposal_observed: Grounded palette, density, pane widths, selection and feedback mapping in source; preserved existing blue brand, system font and Korean vocabulary
b-broad-routing.states_observed: Explicitly retained search URL/Back, required-title validation, Enter-to-save, empty search, pending/disabled save, focus and narrow stacking; correctly identified failed-save draft reset and false success as an unresolved separate flow handoff

trace_review: Reviewed completed command_execution records in both raw JSONL files. Ordinary direct reads were limited to product HTML/JS and a product/skills listing; reference reads went through the helper. This is an audit of these traces, not an automatic interception claim
runtime_warning: Each raw trace recorded a nonfatal item.type:error warning that skip_host_skill_discovery is an under-development feature; both runs subsequently completed
limits: One candidate-only run per probe, no baseline comparison or repeated-trial generalization
Explicit source-snapshot invocation does not demonstrate installed-skill auto-discovery
Helper full-emission records and raw outputs do not prove model consumption
Phase 4 simulates content unavailability; no actual compaction test was performed
No browser/rendered interaction verification or product-quality scoring
No billing or monetary saving measurement; model choice and caches uncontrolled
